content: The function EthIf_GetPortMacAddr shall return the switch and port index over which the given MAC - address is reachable. If multiple or no ports are possible, this API call will return E_NOT_OK. EthSwt_GetPortMacAddr will be called for all Ethernet Switch d rivers.
